steps.content: [Consciousness World]
The blade hovers before Ceto's eye, its dark crimson surface reflecting her shattered form.
Within it, countless overlapping memories surface—
Her first moment on the battlefield, waking to Fynn lifting her into her arms...
Learning to wield a blade for the first time, fighting beside comrades she admired...
Her first true taste of despair, witnessing the face of war unmasked...
And the endless moments of ruin that followed.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: The smell of blood...
Dazed, she looks down at her body, a map of scars and fresh blood. Some wounds were carved by monsters of flesh, others by demons of the mind.
Her torn skin barely holds together the rotting flesh beneath, just as it strains to contain her splintered consciousness. Both teeter on the edge of ruin.
This time... it might be the real end for her.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: It's alright... I've already had a taste of it...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...What it feels like to want to live. To live for myself...
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Everyone, starting today, <color=#fb9259>little Ceto</color> is officially a lighthouse keeper! Let's give her a proper welcome!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Teach me. I want to join. I want to be like you.

steps.speaker: Fynn
steps.content: Now, this is an order... do not look back.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...Yes, Captain!

steps.speaker: Herbert
steps.content: Help me... find peace.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Stop lecturing me! Push! We'll weld the door shut, and you'll be fine!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Miles—!! Speed up! The tide's coming in! Hurry!

steps.speaker: Miles
steps.content: ...POWER—!!! TURN, YOU HUNK OF JUNK! BURN MY BLOOD TO STEAM—I'M GETTING—BACK—!!!

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: Why do you keep fighting? What has it ever gotten you? A number they can erase and reassign? Or just a body of scars that will never truly heal?

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...Shut up.

steps.speaker: Ceto?
steps.content: Why persist as a walking corpse? Let go. You can finally be with them again. Isn't that what you've always wanted?
The blade draws ever closer. Ceto's vision floods with crimson as her body begins to fail, but just as she is about to collapse—
Whoosh—whoosh— A rhythmic sound rises from behind her.
[Back to Reality]
Three short... three long... three short...
It is the flag, still flapping in the wind, its sound flickering like a faint hope in the desperate darkness.

Through bloodshot, blurry eyes, she can just make out <color=#fb9259>that person</color> has not fallen. That frail, slight frame, which nearly broke upon the shore, still stands—defiant, resisting with stubborn resolve.
[Flashback]
You're still alive too. Lucky, aren't we?

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: A nameless bastard has no right to touch the lighthouse.
Isn't a lighthouse meant to guide the lost? Right now, that's me.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're crazy.
I'll take "crazy" as a compliment. If this place is as bad as you say, a little madness might be the only thing that keeps you sane.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...And naive.
I can't stand here and judge your past. What's done is done. But I can prove myself to you. No matter what it takes, I am getting off this rock and finishing what I need to do.
Even when I was surrounded by those things under the sea, I never stopped wanting to see the sun the next morning. Far away, someone is still waiting for me. Someone who needs me.
I saw the inscriptions on the lighthouse's base. The past of the lighthouse keepers... A story DisCity doesn't even know anymore. But you still know.
You remember why they came, the duty they upheld. You're their living legacy.
Well, if it's a lighthouse keeper's specialty, we shouldn't let it go to waste.
Creating miracles is what humans do best.
[Return to Consciousness World] [Small CG: Ceto Alone]

Another, more furious attack crashes down. Ceto meets it with defiance. Excruciating pain tears through every nerve, but she grits through it, lifting her face to stare into those twin pools of crimson—eyes identical to her own.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: These scars... how could they be meaningless...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Do you see that flag?
[Small CG: Chief Behind]
Through the chaos, the figure behind her stands unwavering, a spear-straight silhouette in a tattered coat.

With a sudden, explosive surge of strength, Ceto wrenches herself free from her enemy. Her free hand darts out, seizing the blade leveled at her chest. The edge slices deep into her palm. Blood wells, then falls in perfect, weightless drops, hanging suspended in the air.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I'm not just guarding a lighthouse... I'm keeping a torch lit.
The hovering droplets of blood ignite into sudden, golden flame, and in their blaze, countless shards of memory flash into being.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: It's proof they ever existed.
[Small CG: Fallen Comrades Behind]

Bathed in the golden light, a legion of unyielding souls stands behind Ceto. They are a chorus of struggle, a testament of resistance, their collective will a force that lifts her and drives her forward. One by one, their faint, resolute lights converge upon her form.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I'm still alive. I'm the only one left... the only one who remembers them...
Fynn's song, Herbert's family, Miles's recipe... These memories become her new marrow and blood, a fortifying strength that pulls her back from the abyss.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: They raised me. Their habits became mine. I am the last witness to their sacrifice!

The flames surge, flooding her entire consciousness. The countless silhouettes of fallen comrades spread like sparks upon dry tinder, igniting a wildfire that swells into a boundless, brilliant ocean of light.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: They pulled me from the contamination not to add another body to the grave, but to give hope one last chance to breathe. I've changed my mind, you damned Rancor. Hear this: I will live.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: As long as I live, the lighthouse keepers have not fallen! They stood to the end! They never deserted their post, never abandoned DisCity, never surrendered their honor!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: They will not be forgotten... Fragments of their will survive in me! And they will be with me forever!
Ceto shreds the shadow's disguise. As she launches her counterattack, the dog tags at her waist clash together in a violent, resonant chime.
The Rancor in her hand no longer gleams with bloody light, yet its blows fall with devastating precision, methodically driving the shadow into a corner.
At last, one shattering thrust breaks its defense completely, and Ceto presses her blade against the throat of her own destructive desires!

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I will live to honor the meaning of their lives. And then...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I will find a meaning of my own. A voice of my own.
The Rancor flashes forward. Beneath its unwavering gleam, the shadow disintegrates into nothingness.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You are the one who doesn't deserve to live!
[Back to Reality] [Eyes Opening CG]

Consciousness crashes back into her like a tide. Her blood-red pupils contract sharply; her eyes snap open. In the stark, blinding flashes of lightning, the silhouette before her slowly sharpens into focus.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: You're still here... Tougher than I thought.

She is a vision of gore, with shards of broken pipe jutting from her shoulder and abdomen. Yet a surge of adrenaline overpowers the agony. In one brutal motion, she wrenches a pipe free and rams it through the chest of a lunging monster, nailing its corpse to the window frame.
I told you I would be. I was waiting for you to wake up.
You are hollowed out by exhaustion, your body nearly numb. It is only when you hear movement behind you—a sound long absent—that your body reacts on pure instinct.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...The fleet?

You scrub a hand across your face, clearing the rain, only to feel the slick mix of blood and sweat seep through your fingers. There is no time for such concerns. You look up—and there, on the horizon, pinpoints of light pierce the gloom. The fleet is breaking through the Black Tide.
I can see them approaching. Looks like they've broken through the storm... Soon they'll be...
Cough!

The words die in your throat as a coppery tang floods your mouth. You double over, coughing, and a splatter of blood hits the ground. Ceto, too, has reached her limit. She watches you wipe your lips, and in return, offers a frail, pained smile.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: I see you now. Not a burden... but the most reliable guide in the storm. You should join the lighthouse keepers.
A lookout post with just two people? Sounds... not bad...
Ceto pushes herself upright, her bones protesting the strain. But as her fingers tighten around the hilt of her dagger, the old vulnerability—the confusion that once made her falter—simply vanishes.
The growing dawn catches the lighthouse keeper emblem on her tattered uniform, setting it ablaze with light.
You realize something fundamental has shifted within her. The blade no longer speaks for her; now, it carries her voice.
You did it, Ceto...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Don't celebrate yet. It's not over.
I mean... you... you've found your voice again. You beat the Rancor...

Your taut nerves snap. The exhaustion you've held at bay for so long rushes in, an unstoppable tide. Your vision swims, the world tilts on its axis, and your body plummets toward the base of the lighthouse.
Through the descending haze, you see Ceto whirl around. Her blood-stained fingers stretch out, just brushing your sleeve as you fall...

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Hey! ${PlayerName}!!!
[Collapse] [Fade to Black, Unconscious]
[Heartbeat and Breathing Sounds]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...Who are you?
He never mentioned me to you?
steps.female_content: She never mentioned me to you?

steps.content: [Fade from Black] [Lighthouse Top at Sunrise] [Catherine Portrait]

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You've done well. We'll take it from here.

From below, the sounds of the landing troops and cleanup operations echo up the lighthouse. The moment Ceto's eyes find you, cradled safely in Augustus's arms, the last thread of tension holding Ceto together finally snaps. Her body goes limp as she finally surrenders to the darkness.
